By now you're asking, what can FTP do for me? FTP is used for transferring files from one computer to another. The two basic file types are ASCII and binary.
ASCII files are just text. When files are transferred using the ASCII mode, they are converted when transferred into the format kept on your computer.
The binary transfer mode does not change the files at all as they are transferred. Binary files are programs or compressed files. This is the best mode to transfer files.
